```{r}
recent_sales <- recent_sales %>%
  rename(Home_Sqft = Sqft_value)
```

```{r}
model_4 <- lm(Adjusted_Price ~ Bedrooms + Full_Ba + `3/4Ba` + Half_Ba  + Home_Sqft + Lot_Sqft+ Garage.Spaces+ avg_temp + property_crime_rate + dist_downtown +I(dist_calpoly*CITY_San_Luis_Obispo)  + Age + Pool + Detached + SFR + avg_temp ,
            data = recent_sales,  na.action = na.omit)



summary(model_4)
```

```{r}

library(sjPlot)

recent_sales <- recent_sales %>%
  rename(Three_Quarter_Bath = `3/4Ba`)

```

```{r}
# Install and load necessary package
# install.packages("sjPlot")
# library(sjPlot)

# Custom labels for the variables
labels <- list(
  Bedrooms = "Number of Bedrooms",
  Full_Ba = "Full Bathrooms",
  Three_Quarter_Bath = "Three-Quarter Bathrooms",
  Half_Ba = "Half Bathrooms",
  Home_Sqft = "Home Size (Sqft)",
  Lot_Sqft = "Lot Size (Sqft)",
  Garage.Spaces = "Garage Spaces",
  avg_temp = "Average Temperature",
  property_crime_rate = "Property Crime Rate",
  dist_downtown = "Distance to Downtown",
  `I(dist_calpoly * CITY_San_Luis_Obispo)` = "Interaction: Distance to Cal Poly within SLO",
  Age = "Home Age",
  Pool = "Pool (Yes/No)",
  Detached = "Detached Home (Yes/No)",
  SFR = "Single-Family Residence (Yes/No)"
)

# Fit the model  avg_temp + + Pool + avg_temp dist_downtown + 
              # I(dist_calpoly * CITY_San_Luis_Obispo)  Three_Quarter_Bath +
model_4 <- lm(Adjusted_Price ~ Bedrooms + Full_Ba + Half_Ba + Home_Sqft + Lot_Sqft + 
              Garage.Spaces + property_crime_rate +  + Age  + Detached  ,
              data = recent_sales, na.action = na.omit)

# Generate the professional table with custom labels and adjusted R-squared
tab_model(model_4, show.ci = FALSE, show.se = FALSE, dv.labels = "Adjusted Price", pred.labels = labels)

```

$\text{Price} = \text{Constant} + \beta_1 \text{Home Characteristics} + \beta_2 \text{Location Features} + \epsilon $ 


Price = Constant + \beta_{1} Home Characteristics + \beta_{2} Location Features + \epsilon

```{r}
tab_model(model_4, show.ci = FALSE, show.se = FALSE, dv.labels = "Adjusted Price", pred.labels = labels,
          CSS = list(
            "table" = "font-size: 10px;"  # Adjust font size here
          ))
```


```{r}
# Generate table with HTML font size and reduced row spacing
tab_model(model_4, show.ci = FALSE, show.se = FALSE, 
          show.p = TRUE, show.r2 =  TRUE, 
          dv.labels = "Adjusted Price ($)", pred.labels = labels,
          CSS = list(
            "table" = "font-size: 12px; width: 1000px; height: 300; margin: 0 auto; line-height: 1.0;",  # Adjust line-height here
            "th" = "padding: 0px; text-align: left;",  # Reduce header padding
            "td" = "padding: 0px;"   # Reduce cell padding
          ))

```
